policy.purpose: Index retained outputs without inventing semantics for them.
policy.bytes: preserve exact source bytes and lineage
policy.publication: public routes are linkable; Library-only material stays Library-only
policy.claim_rule: No role, fitness, authority, or meaning claim without an exact route/file, source evidence, or measured interaction result.
policy.unknown_rule: Unknown stays unknown; no synthetic fallback or narrative completion.

count.note: This is a retained-name index. It is not a complete count of files, routes, images, reports, receipts, or source packs.
